summary.text: Mark Thompson is a Republican state representative who has represented Iowa House District 56 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia notes that Thompson served in the U.S. Marine Corps and lists a career as a senior executive and substitute teacher.

paragraphs.text: Mark Thompson served in the U.S. Marine Corps, according to Ballotpedia.
Thompson's career experience includes working as a senior executive and a substitute teacher.
In the 2025-2026 session Thompson was assigned to the House Judiciary, House Local Government, House Veterans Affairs and International Relations committees.
